payload.title: Lab transformer C1: Hosted transformer wiring
payload.description:
Accept `transform` in hosted_curation_routes.py; populate context.priming.transformers; build HTTPTransformer from trusted config (registry env); SigV4 httpx.Auth for Lambda Function URLs; per-binding endpoint.
Acceptance: fake-transformer round trip preview->accept spec; transform refusal test replaced; SigV4 unit-tested without network; no credentials in logs/responses.

Size: L
Dependencies: none (Papyrus P1 is the server side; develop with fakes)
Epic: Lab is the single classifier per publication (decision-flywheel-1b8b860d). Related: hosted curation epic decision-flywheel-1da33407.

Approved by Ryan 2026-10-22; AWS changes need his explicit approval.
